mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that typically precede economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) relative to their 12-month moving averages indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and GDPC1 below 12mo_MA) fails to predict negative returns when correlation with negative returns is <0.1 in absolute value over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing sector weakness that typically triggers recessionary equity market declines, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month indicate strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases by ≥0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% indicates persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate synchronized labor market and manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < previous month and INDPRO < previous month
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS and INDPRO both falling) fails to predict negative returns when Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.
